en.form.promptPlaceholder: e.g. Summarize yesterday's data into a Markdown report.
en.form.workflowAttachmentsHint: Uploaded files are stored in the scheduler's own directory and every fire receives this snapshot. Nodes read `${inputs.附件}` — the newline-joined absolute paths — and parse the documents themselves. Difference from the path fields above: attachments are snapshots, paths read whatever exists at fire time.
en.form.workflowNoFileInputs: This workflow declares no file-typed input, so there is no path field. To hand local files to the workflow, use the attachments above (no declaration needed). Declare a file-typed parameter only when you need a path reference (produced by another job, always the newest file): open 「流程设计」→ the workflow → 「输入参数」 at the top → add a parameter of type 「文件」 and save.
en.form.workflowPathInputsHint: The path is read at every fire (no snapshot). Relative paths resolve against the task working directory; a missing file fails that launch. Your node parses the document itself.
